name: OFX AEX facade contract
purpose: Define the future OFX adapter as a facade over the same AEX broker/worker path, without making OFX the first AEX loader.
forbidden_paths: AviUtlas routes through OFX to reach AEX
OFX adapter bypasses worker identity revalidation
OFX SDK or header code is vendored before license audit

error_contract.worker_crash: OFX render failure without host crash
error_contract.timeout: OFX render failure plus capability warning
error_contract.unsupported_selector: disabled render path or host message
error_contract.gate_denied: no worker render request is issued

notes: This artifact does not implement OFX.
OFX remains deferred until the AEX worker can describe and render at least one reviewed local-build classic CPU effect.
The OFX facade must consume the same capability and loader-gate evidence as AviUtlas direct AEX integration.
A passed OFX facade contract must not change loader_approval.approved, loader_enabled, or real_aex_load_enabled.
